thread:
sarah (sec-eng): Quick sync — Pen-test team asked for a retest window next week. Before we commit, need clarity on RBAC change freeze, KMS key rotation, and audit-log export format. TL;DR: can we freeze infra churn 48h before window and provide JSONL logs + short-lived IAM role for assessor? cc @mike @tera @assessor_bot

mike (infra-ops): We can freeze infra but will need to lock CI pipelines. Can you confirm exact services in-scope? Also: do they need current KMS keys to decrypt archived logs or just access to exported plaintext?

assessor_bot: Assessor request: need an upload bucket s3://redwood-pt-uploads/ with presigned upload creds + role arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/pt-assessor-short for 4h. Preferred logfile format: JSONL with iso8601 timestamps. Hashes OK. Gzip accepted.

tera (platform): On KMS: we rotate monthly but can hold rotation for an engagement. Options: create a dedicated key for PT with rotation disabled, or grant decrypt to an existing key via a temporary key-policy exception. I recommend dedicated "pt-ingest-key".

sarah (sec-eng): Decision proposal: create dedicated KMS key 'pt-ingest-key' w/ rotation disabled and provision pt-assessor-short role with limited decrypt/PutObject permissions. Mike, can you add to infra checklist? I'll draft presigned upload process and redaction guidance.

mike (infra-ops): Adding to checklist. Items:
- Freeze feature flags 48h prior
- Block deploys to prod with tag 'pt-block'
- Create pt-ingest-key (no rotation)
- Provision IAM role pt-assessor-short (4h TTL)
- Export CloudTrail + app logs to s3 prefix /pt/ts-1713456789
- Snapshot RBAC policies and attach artifacts
I'll post the tracker link when artifacts are provisioned.

sarah (sec-eng): Quick note on audit logs: we should include full request/response metadata for 72h; sanitize creds before upload. Assessor ok with redaction patterns (token hashes allowed).

sanjay (security): I'll own the RBAC snapshot and attest to any changes. Sanitize script (run before upload):
```bash
jq 'del(.headers.Authorization, .body.secrets)' input.jsonl > sanitized.jsonl
```
We'll run against last 14 days and include a sha256 manifest of objects.

mike (infra-ops): Tracker created: https://internal.redwood/pt-tracker/1713456789 — adding ACLs and checkboxes. ETA for artifacts: tomorrow 10:00 PT. Calendar ping sent for retest window Mon 2024-05-27 09:00-13:00 PT.

assessor_bot: :thumbsup: Presigned creds request accepted. Please ensure object naming convention: {team}-{env}-{date}-{rand}.gz and include a small README.txt with a manifest.

sarah (sec-eng): One more ask — can oncall be on standby during the window? @oncall-bot please escalate to rotation. We'll also run a quick canary after fixes land.

tera (platform): Oncall has been pinged. I'll snapshot KMS policy into the tracker as soon as pt-ingest-key is created. @mike please avoid rotating unrelated keys until retest completes.

mike (infra-ops): Confirmed. Locking CI and deploy gates now. Will post final checklist + presigned S3 instructions in the tracker when ready.

sarah (sec-eng): Perfect — thanks all. I'll mark this thread 'ready-for-assessor' once presigned link + role ARN are visible in tracker.
